_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Answering thanks and sorry with only yes or okay

segments.text: It means, that is okay, do not worry.
Sorry, I am late. No problem!

native.caption: Mau bilang “tidak apa-apa” dalam bahasa Inggris? Ucapkan “No problem” – artinya tidak masalah, jangan khawatir. Contoh: “Sorry, I am late.” – “No problem!”. Dengarkan Ama, lalu ulangi saat jeda. Latihan lebih lanjut ada di aplikasi Lexkite.

en.caption: Want to say “it is okay” in English? Say “No problem” – it means that is okay, do not worry. Example: “Sorry, I am late.” – “No problem!”. Listen to Ama, then say it in the pause. More practice is in the Lexkite app.
